_step150: the shot leaves on a tap's release (planning step 137): each tap goes down on `tick` and comes up on `release`, the next tick unless it says later
_about: 4-30 (R1 fix 1; re-timed in R3 round 1 for the wave's timing group, in 3b-1's round 1 for the time-base group, and re-authored in 3b-2's round 1 for the knights' sight and shots, planning steps 158 and 159).

The level is dark: its knights see the player only while the ambient is not the darkest value - a lit torch gives them his sight back, a torch put out takes it away - and they always see a placed portal in their row.

A knight looks along its row (floor(y / 128), y 217: row 1), three 128-unit buckets the way it faces, and shoots 41 ticks after a sighting at where he stood (it kills him within 16 units of its flight): the earlier route was spotted by knight A on 569 and shot dead by knight B on 795.
This route has no sighting (no exclamation, no enemy_shot in the run), and unlocks the stealth achievement 76 at the door.
Knight B carries the key and stands at wayB1 inside antiportal_ent_2005 (scale 2, 64 px at 32 x scale); every portal here is 93 px or more from the ring's centre.

A shot at the unlit torch (tap 29, light_off_1689 at (274, 50)) lights it (55) and the light wall goes (149). A portal above the gap at (290, 100) (tap 100, open on 132: row 0, out of the knights' row,

and clear of the lit torch's signal, which circles it at 18 units: a shot that passes within 24 of the signal puts the torch out and the wall back). The player stays on the ledge, in row 0 (y 110), until knight A's patrol

is facing away: A holds at wayA0 (x 54) for about 124 ticks, from about 447 to 567, facing left (its hold ends with a walk right, and it then looks along the whole floor to x 384). Right off the ledge on 355, into the lower room for
shock_diamond_ent_2004 (470) behind A, and back to the pocket under the gap by 556: a portal on the player (tap 559) takes him through the (290, 100) one before A turns (561).
On the ceiling platform (y 114, row 0) a shot at the torch (tap 590) reaches its signal and puts it out (605): the ambient is darkest again, the light wall is back and the knights are blind to him.
Right along the platform and down to the right floor, left along it into knight B, which sees nothing but a portal, and the diamond strikes it (774): its key drops and is taken (775).

Right to x 573.8 (144 u/s, so the hold runs to 928), a portal above the ceiling platform at (530, 50) (a 44-tick flight, opens 987) and one on the player (the first tap of the pair stays unrefused only by waiting for the far one to open): up (990).

A shot from there at the torch (tap 1020, a 69-tick flight) lights it again (1090) and its wall begins to go (1184), 94 ticks on. He walks left along the platform to its end and stops at x 297; a portal at (200, 70) above the ledge (tap 1140, open on 1168) -

not (244, 70), which the earlier route used from the pocket: the lit torch's signal circles within 18 of (274, 50), a shot to (246, 70) passes within 24 of it on some of its phases and puts the torch out again (a draft of this route lost it that way on 1288), while one from the platform's end to (200, 70) stays 48 units off it.

Left off the platform and down the gap, into the lower room once the wall is gone, past A, which holds at wayA0 facing left from 1215 to 1335 (he is to its right, behind it): the key flies to the keyhole (halo 1253) and the yellow door goes (1303).
Back to the pocket (x 273, walk right 1219 to 1262) and a portal on the player (tap 1264): up onto the ledge before A turns (1335) and left into the door.

Won on tick 1337 (the earlier route won on 1458). Windows found by shifting each later stretch of the file on its own by -6, -3, +3 and +6 ticks: all win, with no sighting; the torch's second shot needs 1015 to 1030 (before 1015 the 400 ms refuses it, after 1030 the wall is not gone when he reaches it). Leans on G1 (planning steps 158 and 159: the knights' cone, buckets and blindness in the dark, the torch toggle of steps 27 and 158), G10 (the walk is 144 u/s, no steering in the air) and G4 (the shot flies 3.2 units a tick after a 24-unit jump).
